name: 肩の位置合わせ解析
algorithm: Shoulder Alignment — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes shoulder movement patterns for deepfake detection:

1. **Shoulder検出&トラッキング**: Shoulder landmarks (acromion processes, deltoid contours, shoulder line angle) are tracked per frame. The shoulder line provides reference for head-body alignment and upper body posture.

2. **Head-ShoulderCoordination**: Head and shoulder movements are biomechanically coupled — large head rotations involve shoulder contribution, nodding produces subtle shoulder adjustments. The method measures head-shoulder temporal correlation. Face-swap deepfakes that only modify the face may show decoupled head-shoulder dynamics.

3. **Breathing動き検出**: Shoulders rise subtly during inspiration and fall during expiration. The method detects respiratory shoulder motion (0.2-0.33 Hz) as a biological authenticity signal. Deepfake videos that don't model breathing may show shoulders without respiratory motion.

4. **Shoulder-ClothingInteraction**: Shoulder movement should produce corresponding clothing deformation — fabric stretch, fold formation, collar shifts. The method checks shoulder-clothing dynamic coupling. Generated shoulders may show movement without physically correct clothing response.

5. **時間的Shoulder安定性**: In steady posture, shoulder position should be stable with only breathing-related and physiological tremor micro-motion. The method tracks shoulder stability — anomalous shoulder jitter, position drift, or contour instability indicates deepfake generation artifacts at the body-face interface.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through shoulder alignment analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
